data.title: Step 1: set the *finish line*
data.subtitle: Step 1 of 6 in the self-check loop.

items: Say what it's for and who reads it
List 3 to 7 tests it must pass
Ask Claude to add any you missed
Agree the list before it starts

blocks.text: Before you start, write the finish line: 3 to 7 tests this must pass to be done and right. Wait for my OK.
**You'll get back:** a numbered list of tests. Edit it, then say OK.
Use it before any draft that matters.

items: Main point in the first line

blocks.new: Done means: one page, three risks, each with a source.

blocks.text: Anthropic's guides: be specific about the output you want, and say up front what **done** means.
A check needs something to check against.
